propositions: rebar verify-commit-ticket fails with 'ticket store not found' in a fresh linked worktree because pure intercepts skip the centralized store-mount step
store mount logic is replicated per dispatch-arm and entirely skipped by pure intercepts, making it structurally possible for commands to bypass initialization
mount gate must run at a single central CLI choke point before pure intercepts and set-based dispatch to guarantee all store-touching commands perform store initialization
commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must be exempted from forced auto-mount while other commands receive guaranteed mount coverage
library imports and MCP intentionally do not auto-mount and should remain unchanged; only CLI surface requires centralized mount enforcement
